all_reduce_tensor: all-reduce a torch tensor across the tensor model parallel group
all_gather_tensor: all-gather a torch tensor across the tensor model parallel group along a dimension
reduce_scatter_tensor: reduce-scatter a torch tensor across the tensor model parallel group along a dimension
gather_tensor: gather a torch tensor across the tensor model parallel group to a destination rank
broadcast_tensor_dict: broadcast a dictionary of tensors across the tensor model parallel group from a source rank
